name: Registered wallet trigger
text: After a transfer out of the registered creator wallet, charge 5% on subsequent sells in the $HOOK pool for 30 minutes.

name: Steady fees
text: Set a 0.3% fee on buys and sells.

name: Opening window
text: Charge 2% on sells for ten minutes, then 0.5%. Charge 0.3% on buys throughout.

name: Fee-free debut
text: Use no swap fees for the first hour, then 0.5% on buys and sells.
